name: How do I choose a reliable storm damage restoration company?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a reliable storm damage restoration company?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for a company with certifications in restoration services, such as IICRC. Check their experience with similar storm damage situations and ask for references. Ensure they are properly licensed and insured in your area. A transparent estimate, clear communication, and availability for emergency services are also key indicators of a reliable company. Avoid companies that pressure you into decisions or demand large upfront payments.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a certified, experienced, licensed, and insured company with transparent pricing and good communication for storm damage restoration.
